ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white/off-white) to 15% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A dominant high-intensity white field covers both lobes. A distinct low-intensity black margin follows the entire trailing edge contour. A significant, irregularly shaped vertical cluster of low-intensity pixels is localized at the base of the median notch. Scattered low-intensity circular mottling is distributed across the central and inner-left lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 42 degrees and deep vertical penetration relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire boundary; amplitudes are minimal (approx. 2-4 pixels) near the notch and increase to significant jagged peaks (approx. 10-18 pixels) at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep; the left lobe displays a pronounced upward-convex curve, while the right lobe displays a more linear, slightly downward-sloping trajectory toward the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, roughly circular dark pixel clusters ranging from 5 to 12 pixels in diameter are visible across the mid-section of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, segmented dark vertical marking or lesion is present at the junction of the two lobes near the notch; visible irregular notches on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe indicate prior structural tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: The large central dark marking exhibits a unique, nearly rectangular internal structure with several high-contrast white pixels embedded within it.
